claims.claim: Left Barcelona in May 2026 after 14 seasons
claims.note: AP: announced Tuesday 26 May 2026; 14 seasons.

claims.claim: Joined Barcelona in 2012 at 18 from Levante

claims.claim: 507 games, 232 goals (club record), 38 trophies, 4 Champions Leagues, 10 league titles
claims.note: All figures stated in AP article.

claims.claim: Fourth Champions League title on Saturday, 'fourth time in six seasons'
claims.note: AP gives the phrase and Saturday; no calendar date is given and none is in the body.

claims.claim: Announcement on Tuesday 26 May 2026; quotes 'The time has come...' and 'a perfect story'
claims.note: Quotes match AP text (AP says 'It's been a perfect story').

claims.claim: Farewell at Camp Nou on the Wednesday after the announcement, over 91,000 people chanted her name
claims.note: FC Barcelona: Wednesday 27 May 2026, more than 91,000.

claims.claim: 'an incredible emptiness', 'full of love'
claims.note: Quotes present.

claims.claim: Xavi Llorens brought her back; no ceiling as a player or person
claims.note: Source says she returned at one of the most difficult times in her life; the article's paraphrase is consistent.

claims.claim: Tribute videos (Puyol, Busquets, Iniesta, Pedri, Raphinha), Vicky Lopez 'an example on and off the field', Magnolias, academy for 400+ girls with the Foundation, team photo, gift, collective hug

claims.claim: Family and friends attended; Rafael Yuste and Joan Laporta spoke

claims.claim: 'a world leader in women's football', 'has changed the face of women's football'
claims.note: Quotes present.

claims.claim: Lifting the fourth CL trophy as a determining moment in deciding to leave
claims.note: Source: 'a determining moment in understanding that now was the time'.

claims.claim: Club's first women's Ballon d'Or winner (2021); 2020 edition cancelled due to Covid-19; 2022 record two wins; first two-time winner in consecutive years
claims.note: All stated on the club page.

claims.claim: Quotes 'when I won a year ago...' and 'I'm proud to play for Barca, my lifetime club'
claims.note: Both quotes present.

claims.claim: Born 4 February 1994, Mollet del Valles, Spain; nationality Spanish; attacking midfield

claims.claim: Signed for London City Lionesses on Wednesday 8 July 2026; 'statement signing'; age 32; Barcelona contract expired end of June

claims.claim: Club owned by Michele Kang, who also owns OL Lyonnes; promoted in 2025 and sixth in first season in 12-team division

claims.claim: Quotes from Putellas and Kang

claims.claim: World Cup winner with Spain; part of 2023 World Cup squad; named world's best female player 2021 and 2022
